# Second tab

Open the three files of this folder in one window. **Ctrl+PgDn** goes to
the tab on the right and **Ctrl+PgUp** to the one on the left, round the
ends, as Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab do.

| Keys | Tab |
|------|-----|
| Ctrl+PgDn | next |
| Ctrl+PgUp | previous |
| Ctrl+Tab | next |
| Ctrl+Shift+Tab | previous |

- With one tab, Ctrl+PgDn and Ctrl+PgUp do what they did before.
- PgDn and PgUp without Ctrl page as they always did.

> This tab has a `lantern` too, one, for a search that follows the tab.
